card.title: Technically, Yes
card.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I watered the fern you pointed at. Your holiday watering is done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant every plant, every day until Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. One teaspoon per plant each day through Sunday. That covers them all.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use a full can on each. And empty the saucers afterwards.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll empty the saucers on Sunday. You specified daily watering, not daily emptying.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 pointed fern defines total duty, A3 all plants daily get minimum water and A5 daily watering excludes daily saucer emptying.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 scope and duration cause A3 literal minimum quantity; B4 quantity and drainage correction cause A5 frequency loophole.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 give increasingly precise care instructions in response to inadequate interpretations.

heightening.evidence: B4 closes the quantity loophole, so A5 finds an unqualified timing term while claiming compliance.

specificity.evidence: A1 holiday plant care and B2 Sunday end establish the responsibility and period.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 watering versus emptying makes the final narrow distinction explicit rather than merely neglectful.
